Install hyprland-preview-share-picker-git on Omarchy

This is the git/development-snapshot build of hyprland-preview-share-picker, Hyprland's alternative screen-share picker. It replaces the default text-only picker with live thumbnail previews of open windows and connected monitors in a tabbed GTK4 window, so you can confirm what you're sharing before a call or recording starts. Being the -git package, it tracks the latest unreleased commits rather than a tagged release.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add hyprland-preview-share-picker-git
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.2.1.r0.g211b789-1:
    pacman -Qi hyprland-preview-share-picker-git

Open and use hyprland-preview-share-picker-git

hyprland-preview-share-picker-git is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql hyprland-preview-share-picker-git | grep applications

hyprland-preview-share-picker-git requirements and compatibility

  • Hyprland window manager
  • xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
  • GTK4 and GTK4 Layer Shell installed
  • slurp (optional, for manual region selection)
  • Rust nightly toolchain to build from source

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • gtk4
  • gtk4-layer-shell
  • xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
  • hyprland

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: MIT.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install hyprland-preview-share-picker-git on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add hyprland-preview-share-picker-git. The download is 2.5 MB and it takes 6.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is hyprland-preview-share-picker-git free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall hyprland-preview-share-picker-git?

Run omarchy pkg drop hyprland-preview-share-picker-git. It removes the package from your system.

What does hyprland-preview-share-picker-git depend on?

The package declares 4 dependencies: gtk4, gtk4-layer-shell, xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland, hyprland. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is hyprland-preview-share-picker-git a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for hyprland-preview-share-picker-git.

Is hyprland-preview-share-picker-git in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as hyprland-preview-share-picker-git (version 0.2.1.r0.g211b789-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. WhySoBad makes it.
